verdicts.reason: A: the 'Lima & Co Group' wordmark has been moved off its navy circle onto the white and gold halftone circle and shrunk. It is white on white over a busy pattern, so you can't read it at all, and the navy circle on the right is left as an empty slab. B makes the same error: the text sits across the white halftone area, so 'Lima &' and 'Group' disappear and only the 'o' of 'Co' shows against the navy. B is marginally less invisible, but in both the only text, the brand name, is unreadable and sits on a busy image, so neither can ship.
